winner.title: Baleadas: A Favorite Honduran Street Food

evidence.authenticity: Honduran-born author; from-scratch flour tortillas, blended and fried red beans, queso fresco, Honduran cream with sour cream sub; puffed-tortilla cue is a Honduran standard. No history or roots section.
evidence.precision: Only 1 of 17 ingredients has a weight (1 lb flour); water amount inconsistent (1 1/4 cups vs 2 1/4 cups). Good cues: 5-7 min knead until soft and flexible, 6 inch tortillas, 6-7 sec first flip then pale and opaque, pat to puff, beans to hummus consistency. No pan size or temperatures.
evidence.testing: Little reasoning given; notes Hondurans judge a tortilla by its puff. Rest and stir instructions given without explanation. No ratings.
evidence.photos: Only a hero image (confirmed by WebFetch); no process photos.
evidence.efficiency: Roughly 1h35m total, mostly the 45 min dough rest; sensible parallel work for beans.
evidence.access: Everything at a US grocery; subs given for Honduran cream, shortening, and cheese.

winner.why: Best authenticity and cues for a from-scratch tortilla and beans, narrowly ahead of the gram-weighted Spanish recipe, but it falls under 60 because of missing weights, photos and testing detail.

runnerUp.title: Baleadas hondureñas, esta es la receta base que puedes enriquecer al gusto (aunque tal cual ya es deliciosa)

evidence.authenticity: Includes the Honduran mantequilla (butter and cream) spread and a flour tortilla, but the author is Spanish and uses canned beans and crème fraîche.
evidence.precision: Grams or ml for 10 of 11 ingredients; cues include dough slightly sticky but manageable, flip when it puffs and bubbles; one run-on step, no temperatures or pan size; the baking powder amount is not given.
evidence.testing: Some explanation of dough hydration and leaving a border so the filling stays in.
evidence.photos: 8 images on the page, no step images in schema.
evidence.efficiency: 30 min stated, with a 30 min dough rest, so the time is understated.
evidence.access: Spanish language; crème fraîche is a substitution for Honduran cream.

runnerUp.why: Most precise, but Spanish-language, non-Honduran author and a single block of steps.

candidates.disqualified: Paywalled; shortcut with store-bought tortillas and refried beans, baked.
Redirects to site home page; no recipe
